language.note: Closely related to Galician, spoken just across the northern border in Spain — part of the same West Iberian dialect continuum

terrainDescription.zh: 北部多山地與河谷，中南部漸趨平緩，大西洋沿岸線綿長，南部阿爾加維地區屬地中海型氣候。
terrainDescription.en: Mountainous river valleys in the north giving way to gentler terrain further south, a long Atlantic coastline, and a Mediterranean climate in the southern Algarve.

plate.color: white background, black text (front and rear)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Wedge-shaped with a noticeably thin white top, or flat with a wide reflector (mostly white, sometimes orange)

utilityPole.transformerMount: Concrete "ladder" poles with very tall steps, each often with a small see-through hole — taller/more pronounced ladder rungs than Spain's; wooden poles also occur

historicalContext.zh: 葡萄牙語與西班牙加利西亞語同屬伊比利亞羅曼語連續體，兩者歷史淵源極深；鄉間常見紅白配色的菱形或長方形狩獵警示標誌，是葡萄牙鄉村路景的特色之一。
historicalContext.en: Portuguese and Galician (spoken in northwest Spain) share deep historical roots within the West Iberian Romance dialect continuum. Red-and-white diamond or rectangular hunting-warning signs are a distinctive feature of the Portuguese countryside.
